New Wild Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia

Scientists have identified a new species of wild cat in Bolivia, the first such discovery in over a century. The species, named Leopardus tilcayo, was initially mistaken for a domestic pet. It is described as being slightly smaller than a domestic cat, measuring approximately 45 centimeters in length. The discovery marks a significant find in feline species identification.
